smartphone.reviewer: Codex native-pipeline agent, AI-assisted visual inspection
smartphone.scope: Local official Canvas/source comparison at the authored peak for all 32 actions, with all overview pairs and enlarged actions 17–32 inspected. Approval is limited to these rendered captures.
observations: Native and source silhouettes, expressions, original lettering, hand variants, cable and layered body geometry agree visually.
Limbs remain joined; Jump is visibly airborne and the inspected poses remain inside the capture.
No native/source discrepancy requiring motion or adapter changes was observed.

additionalReview.reviewer: Codex animation-authoring agent, separate AI-assisted inspection
additionalReview.scope: All five 32-pair overviews; enlarged flip-phone/app-bot/pager mood sheets and smartphone/handheld movement sheets.
additionalReview.result: Native/source pairs agree visually, original lettering is readable, limbs remain joined, and the authored Jump is visible without clipping; no motion change requested.

limitations: Peak contact sheets do not independently verify every intermediate frame, state-machine behavior, browser/device rendering or full website accessibility.
Browser workflow remains BLOCKED; this review does not authorize WebGL promotion.
